gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i1: Tests {@link CharRange#contains(CharRange)}.

A {@code CharRange} describes either a contiguous block of characters (normal) or everything outside that block
ADDED i2: Single-character ranges: each matches exactly one letter.
ADDED i3: Normal (non-negated) multi-character ranges, named after their endpoints.
ADDED i5: Negated ranges: match every character EXCEPT the named block.
ADDED i6: The full character space, and everything except the very first character.
ADDED i9: 'not b-d' contains a normal range exactly when that range avoids 'b'-'d'.
ADDED i10: 'not c-d' contains a normal range exactly when that range avoids 'c'-'d'.
ADDED i11: --- negated range contains negated range --- 'not X' contains 'not Y' only when the excluded block X is within block Y.
